CLI ​

text
tuimark — a view language for terminals

usage:
  tuimark dump     FILE [--cols 80] [--rows 24] [--format text|json] [--data FILE.json]
                        [--cells] [--styles] [--strict] [--theme dark|light]
  tuimark validate FILE [--json] [--strict] [--catalog FILE] [--data FILE.json] [--theme dark|light]
  tuimark preview  FILE [--cols 80] [--rows 24] [--data FILE.json] [--watch] [--theme dark|light]
                        [--color truecolor|256|16|none]
  tuimark play     FILE [--cols 80] [--rows 24] [--data FILE.json] [--theme dark|light]
                        [--input STEPS | --script FILE.ndjson]
                        [--format text|json] [--cells] [--styles] [--frames] [--strict]
  tuimark fmt      FILE [--write] [--check]
  tuimark ir       FILE                       print the source IR as JSON
  tuimark agents   [--repo | --project]       print AGENTS.md generated from the catalog
                                               (--project: the briefing tuimark new writes)
  tuimark catalog                             print the closed vocabulary as JSON
  tuimark new      NAME [--go | --ts]         create a project: app.tui, theme.tcss, sample.json, AGENTS.md
  tuimark test     [DIR] [--update] [--allow-breaking]
                                               check dump goldens under DIR (default testdata/golden)
  tuimark inspect  FILE (--at X,Y | --id ID) [--cols 80] [--rows 24] [--data FILE.json]
                        [--theme dark|light] [--strict] [--json]
                                               explain one node: path, classes, pseudo-classes, styles
  tuimark run      FILE [--data FILE.json] [--theme dark|light] [--events FILE.ndjson]
                        [--mock FILE.json] [--strip]
                                               run in the terminal: F12 shows the events, edits reload
  tuimark host     FILE [--data FILE.json] [--theme dark|light] [--reply-timeout 5s]
                                               run in the terminal for a parent program (fd 3 in, fd 4 out)
  tuimark mcp                                 a Model Context Protocol server on stdin/stdout
  tuimark lsp                                 a Language Server Protocol server on stdin/stdout
  tuimark version

exit codes: 0 ok, 1 I/O or crash, 2 validation errors

Commands ​

CommandWhat it doesGuide
dumpRenders one frame: the grid, every node's geometry, and the diagnostics. Text by default, --format json for agents.Dumps and tools
validateChecks a document without printing a frame. Lays it out at 40, 80, and 120 columns to find layout and bind problems.Getting started
previewThe text dump, plus the frame painted in ANSI colors when stdout is a terminal. --watch re-renders on save.Getting started
playReplays keys, typing, pastes, clicks, and store changes with no terminal, and prints the final frame plus every action that fired.Dumps and tools
inspectExplains one cell or node: its layout path, classes, pseudo-classes, and which rule set each property.Dumps and tools
fmtThe canonical formatter. --check exits 2 when a file is not formatted.Dumps and tools
irPrints the parsed document as JSON, before the stylesheet cascade.Dumps and tools
testCompares dumps with the goldens a manifest lists; --update rewrites them.Testing
agentsPrints the AGENTS.md briefing, generated from the runtime's own catalogs. --project prints the briefing new writes into a project.Working with agents
catalogPrints the closed vocabulary (tags, attributes, properties, keys, actions, diagnostic codes) as JSON, each item with the document version that accepts it.Dumps and tools
newCreates a project: app.tui, theme.tcss, sample.json, and AGENTS.md; --go or --ts adds the program that hosts it.Dumps and tools
runRuns a document in the terminal with no host program: an event strip (F12), an --events log, --mock store writes, and reload on save.Running a document
versionPrints the version.

Exit codes ​

CodeMeaning
0ok
1usage error, I/O error, or crash; nothing useful on stdout
2the document has an error-severity diagnostic (dump, validate, play, inspect, ir), a file is not formatted (fmt --check), or a golden does not match (test)

run exits 0 when the session quits or its input ends, and 128 + the signal number when a stop signal ends it.

--cols and --rows take 1 to 1000. dump, validate, play, inspect, ir, fmt, and test never read TUIMARK_* environment variables, so their output never depends on the machine they run on.
